newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady after new all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady after new all-time high.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be steady on Friday after hitting an all-time high at 735.49 points at Thursday's closing and on the likelihood that the government will announce new deregulation measures, brokers said.

They said buying interest would continue and would be well-spread. Counters which will benefit from an economic deregulation package which is likely to be announced on Friday will be in focus, they added.
Government sources told Reuters that Indonesia is likely to announce the package after a mini-cabinet meeting on Friday.

Sources in the finance ministry said the long-delayed deregulation package was complete and would be on the agenda of the meeting. Barring any last minute hitches, the measures should be announced later in the day, they said.
Brokers said the sharp rise in the Dow Jones average overnight would provide a further boost to overall sentiment and spur fresh buying in big-capitalised stocks such as Telkom TLKM.
But they added that the week's sharp rises in the index could spark profit-taking, which would cap any strong surge.
Further buying is also likely to be seen on secondaries such as property firms Surya Semesta Internusa and Bakrieland Development, they said.
On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index ended 5.34 points, or 0.73 percent higher, at a record high of 735.49.
